project.name: Barcelona Compare
project.purpose: A trilingual (ES/EN/CA) directory comparing nail salons and massage businesses in Barcelona. Static Astro site on Cloudflare Pages, plus a small edge registry (Cloudflare Pages Functions + D1) so that the person who runs a listed business can claim the listing and manage the content that is published about it.
project.owner: Rutger (raitgerb). Coordination: Agrippa. Bounded code implementation: Builder.

module_exclusions.rationale: No payment or fulfilment path is active. The paid partner tier is deliberately on hold by owner decision until the ~20-claimed-partner gate is met, no Stripe integration exists, and the collection budget is a hard $0 ceiling.

release.authority: Owner Rutger grants release authority per change through the coordination handoff; the standing grant is 'ship a reviewed PR', not 'deploy anything'. Security, auth, payment, migration and credential changes additionally require independent review before release (Project Standard v1.0.0, SENSITIVE change-risk gate). The bounded exception of 2026-09-21 authorizes exactly one stage-1 maintenance-guard release with the pre-existing, guard-unrelated gaps marked EXEMPT below; it authorizes no other release, it does NOT authorize or pre-approve the ownership/migration release, and it expires at review 2026-09-28.
release.procedure: Rebase onto origin/main, run the declared test commands plus the build, open a PR that states the reviewed revision, obtain the required Cloudflare Pages check, squash-merge, then read back the deployment id, commit hash and live page bytes. Record the receipt in data/release-receipt.json (kept git-ignored: a receipt cannot name its own commit, see project-foundations docs/declaration-schema.md), with the human-readable evidence committed under docs/release-evidence/.
release.rollback: Revert the offending commit on a new branch and merge the revert (main is protected, so no force-push and no history rewrite). Deployment rollback target captured by API readback on 2026-09-21 immediately before this release (GET /accounts/135a01b78b043167860618dd0030c5f6/pages/projects/barcelona-compare): production deployment 5772f80c-bcdc-4815-973a-9b6e00cc648c, commit 10ab9621f533f9b8351dd48c7af60ac7118c231d, aliases ['https://barcelonacompare.com'], latest_stage deploy/success - this is the pre-change production state and the exact target to roll back to (rollback by deployment id). This release writes no D1/R2 state, so no data rollback is required and none is performed. Database rollback needs its own plan: migrations are forward-only files applied in filename order and are never rewritten; a bad migration is corrected by a new migration. Re-run npm run db:migrate:local to rebuild the local schema.
release.verification: Compare the deployed commit hash from the Pages API against the merged commit, then fetch the changed route from the live host and assert on its content (title/canonical/body marker) rather than its status code. For the stage-1 maintenance guard: fetch every guarded ownership route on the PRODUCTION host and assert HTTP 503 with the x-maintenance-guard response marker plus content-type application/json, cache-control no-store and a JSON maintenance body, on the merged commit; then assert the unaffected surfaces still serve (static and listing detail pages 200 with their build-time base content and no owner-content injection, GET /api/registry 200, POST /api/track 200). Synthetic/malformed request bodies are used only AFTER the guard marker has been observed on a plain GET, and no real claimant's data is used. /js/portfolio-analytics.js is re-fetched and matched against sha256 7f231e76d757511d370f025f70683ed78888e39c865ef4dacd0c948eedd8dea9 to show the analytics loader was not disturbed. analytics/registry read-back uses the operator token.
